subject: Business Models
title: Domino's Tech Transformation
description: A micro-lesson that makes Domino's Tech Transformation usable.

hook.text: In 2010, Domino's ran an ad admitting its pizza was terrible. Then it reinvented itself as a tech company.

buildup.text: Domino's built a pizza tracker, one-click ordering, and delivery by drone experiments before any competitor.

discovery.text: Over 75% of Domino's orders are digital. Its stock rose 5,000% in a decade—beating Amazon and Google.

twist.text: Domino's CEO said 'We're a technology company that happens to deliver pizza.' The product became secondary.

climax.text: Domino's proved that franchise empires can reinvent themselves through technology, not just food innovation.

punchline.text: Bad pizza, great app. 5,000% stock return. Tech saved the franchise.

quiz.question: What percentage of Domino's orders are placed digitally?

details.summary: Domino's transformed from a struggling pizza chain into a technology company that happens to deliver pizza. It invested heavily in app ordering, GPS delivery tracking, voice AI ordering, and data analytics. Over half of Domino's orders now come through digital channels.
details.whyItMatters: Domino's technology investment turned it from a commodity pizza brand into the most technologically advanced restaurant chain. It proves that even traditional franchise models can be disrupted and reinvented through technology-first thinking.
takeaways: Domino's invested in apps, AI, and tracking systems as a tech-first strategy
Over 50 percent of orders come through digital channels and apps
Technology investment drove stock price growth of over 5,000 percent in a decade

faq.question: What technology innovations did Domino's introduce?
faq.answer: A mobile ordering app with pizza tracker, voice-activated ordering through Alexa and Google Home, AI-powered inventory management, GPS driver tracking, autonomous delivery vehicle testing, emoji ordering via text message, and zero-click ordering that automatically places your usual order.

faq.question: How did technology investment specifically improve Domino's business?
faq.answer: Digital orders have higher average ticket sizes and lower error rates. Data analytics optimize delivery routes and kitchen workflows. Predictive ordering reduces wait times. The technology creates switching costs as customers invest in profiles and saved orders.
